title: Summary Utilization % is the weighted rate, not the average of the per-technician percentages
custom_preconds: 1. Two visible technicians with deliberately skewed hours - e.g. tech A: 1.00 total / 1.00 WO (100%); tech B: 9.00 total / 0.00 WO (0.0%) - so the weighted and averaged results differ clearly.
custom_steps:
1. Compute the weighted rate: summed WO hours ÷ summed clocked hours × 100 (10% in the example).
2. Compute the naive average of the two row percentages (50% in the example).
3. Read the Summary Utilization %.
custom_expected:
1. The Summary Utilization % shows the WEIGHTED rate - the visible technicians' total work-order hours as a percentage of their total clocked hours, from unrounded hours (10.0% in the example).
2. It is NOT the average of the per-technician percentages (not 50.0%).
